integrity: Contains an exact probabilistic proof, finite standard-library numerical and rational arithmetic checks, and explicit acknowledgment of the strongest known overlapping qualitative result.
scientific_limitations: Exact off-origin relocation probability one, fixed impurity probability strictly between zero and one, origin start. The additive limit is not assigned a distribution or proved nondegenerate; no uniform parameter asymptotic is claimed. Qualitative strong-memory neighbor concentration was previously discussed and is not the priority claim.
title: Sharp logarithmic origin-visit law at perfect preferential resetting
